name: Belgian Popcorn
summary: The movement has been described as Europe's last truly underground subcultural scene due to its relative obscurity outside Belgium and lack of commercialization.
description: The movement has been described as Europe's last truly underground subcultural scene due to its relative obscurity outside Belgium and lack of commercialization. Though similar in timeline to Britain's Northern Soul , Popcorn is differentiated by its slower pace, its focus on "slow swing" dancing, and its association with beer consumption rather than amphetamines. [ 1 ] The movement is regarded as the cultural predecessor to the Belgian New Beat movement of the 1980s.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Exclusivity, style, self-respect, community, decadence, historical reverence
